"Neverwinter Nights: Tyrants of the Moonsea" v2.5
A Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition Premium Module

Developed by Ossian Studios® Inc. and based on the original module by Luke Scull
Published by Beamdog

Starting Level: 15
Number of Players: 1

The harsh frontier land known as the Moonsea is besieged by demons. A mysterious cult has arisen, bent on death and destruction. Amid the chaos, war is imminent between the powerful city states and their tyrannical rulers. Accompanied by the dwarf merchant Madoc, you approach the town of Voonlar just as the worst storm of the year hits. You soon discover that only you can prevent the total annihilation of the Moonsea at the hands of a legendary and ancient evil...
As the old Moonsea battle cry goes: "Dare ... and beware!"
